evidence_excerpts: PARTIAL-GENERIC-ESSENCE Being F is partially what it is to be G iff: there is some H such that for a thing to be G is for it to be both F and H (in symbols: Gx ºx Fx Ù Hx).
text: Partial generic essence is captured by conjunctive partial generalized identity: being F is partially what it is to be G exactly when being G is being both F and some H.
